capabilities.description: Owns high-level AI reasoning, capability selection, and final-result generation while Core retains capability execution authority.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion base URL (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 or https://api.openai.com/v1)

fields.label: Model Name
fields.description: Upstream model identifier (e.g. qwen2.5:7b, gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini)

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Secret API key for upstream provider authentication (optional for local Ollama)

fields.label: Mock / Offline Mode
fields.description: When true, returns deterministic canonical AI responses offline without network access. When false, requires base_url and model.
